::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**Everything on this page is generated, not written.** It was produced by
[NotebookLM]({{< var companion.notebook_url >}}) from the workshop's own
handbook and notebooks, and no human wrote or checked a sentence of it. Use it
as a *second pass* over material you have already seen, and check anything it
asserts against the [handbook](tensors_workshop_plan_with_quizzes.md) — never
the other way round. Generated {{< var companion.exported >}}.
:::

The workshop itself is built on a promise: real data, and numbers you can
reproduce. This page keeps that promise by being clear about which side of the
line it sits on. It is here because a different explanation of the same
material is genuinely useful — a video before the session, a diagram to argue
with, a quiz on the train home — not because it replaces anything.

Where an artifact can be **exported**, it is, and it is served from this
site: no account, no sign-in, and it still works if the notebook is later
edited or deleted. Three of them cannot be exported at all, and some that can
be are links into NotebookLM until that export happens. Both of those ask you
for a Google account. Each section below says which of the three it is.

## Listen {#listen}

The Audio Overview is two hosts talking through the workshop. It is the only

on a commute the day before.

## Test yourself {#test-yourself}

Neither of these is the [Kahoot](kahoot.qmd). The Kahoot quizzes are six
questions each, run live in the room after sections 04, 07 and 10, and they
were written for this workshop. These two are generated, unlimited and for
your own use afterwards.

**Both open in NotebookLM and need a Google account** — quizzes and flashcards
are the artifacts NotebookLM does not let you export.

{{< include _includes/companion-selfcheck-en.md >}}
